content:
Girl math has officially entered the bra department.

If I’m going to wear something for 10 hours, I’m counting that as a full-time employee.

So naturally, I expect benefits. 

I’ve been seeing underneat.in’s JellySoft™️ Bra pop up on my feed lately, and honestly, it seems to be ticking the right boxes.

Wire-free, soft and flexible, made for wearing through a full day without constantly thinking about it.

Also I was looking for reviews & found out that Underneat is sending these bras with a 3D jelly block. 
Like wow.

So by girl math, that's a win win. 
You get a product you love + a cute packaging to feel more “happy happy”

Underneat has made the maths look totally flawless.
comment: The interesting shift is how comfort products are being judged beyond function. Long-wear categories win when brands solve the small daily frustrations customers usually accept as normal.
